source: Cartographer prototypes, READMEs on branches prototype/msagl-layout and prototype/plan-layout, measured 2026-11-20. Moved counts leaf boxes only. Times are single runs: layout + routing + labels. MSAGL scan 1 sheet was 2420 x 4960 px, which is 242 x 496 steps. Container cuts, bends, length, labels over lines and sheet size for MSAGL were not in the READMEs: they were measured on 2026-11-20 by re-running the MSAGL prototype with a layout dump added and applying Groma's own measures to its drawings (lengths converted from pixels to 10 px steps). Groma's crossing counter gave 11, 20, 23 on the real sheet, as the README reports, and 1032, 1040, 908 on the large one against the README's 1032, 1025, 901; the difference comes from the prototype's half-pixel tolerance.
